title: Assembling underused land

captions.instagram:
After the Wiz, I assembled underutilized parcels across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and New Jersey.

Assemblage means combining neighboring lots into one site that can support a bigger plan. It's slower and more complex than buying one lot, and it opens more options.

Save the 5 questions before assembling a site.

captions.facebook:

#RealEstate #NYC

Have you seen a block transformed by one project?
captions.linkedin:
One lot is limited by its size. An assembled site is limited by your patience.

After the Wiz, I moved into waterfront revitalization and real estate development, assembling underutilized parcels across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and New Jersey. That work led to JemRock Organization.

Assemblage combines neighboring parcels into one site that can support a larger plan: find, acquire, combine, plan. It takes several negotiations instead of one.

Five questions before assembling a site: Who owns each parcel? What does zoning allow combined? What does each piece cost? What happens if one owner says no? What could the full site become?

#RealEstate #UrbanDevelopment
